research_question: How much do target-facing approach/contact surface, roll pose, Taylor source-axis candidate, munition profile and nested replicate count R change KMFC upstream support and legacy damage-tree output distributions?

design.common_random_number_rule: each complete candidate_key(face, grid_index, roll_deg, profile) has one unique aleatory seed; only its two source-axis interventions share that seed
design.epistemic_limitation: A single fixed target-parameter realization isolates paired software effects but cannot quantify epistemic variance or factor-by-epistemic interactions.
design.label_denominator_rule: accepted first-contact simulations only; refused/diagnostic-error candidates remain in the ledger and are excluded from every label denominator

paired_axis_effects.pairing: Same candidate key, target realization, aleatory seed, face, point, roll, profile, speed and nested replicate prefix; source axis sign only.
paired_axis_effects.bootstrap_scope: Intervals are fixed-diagnostic-grid paired stability intervals. They are not confidence intervals for an operational population.

roll_sensitivity_r8.interpretation: Roll is about the velocity/body +X axis.  Any observed effect is sensitivity of the finite fragment realization and target geometry, not a change in aim.

interaction_spread.interpretation: The spread is a descriptive source-axis-by-roll interaction on the fixed grid. It is not an operational-population interaction coefficient.

interpretation_guards.axis: +body-X is a counterfactual intervention only; it is not a validated production fix
interpretation_guards.sampling: balanced diagnostic grid is not an operational reference distribution
interpretation_guards.R: nested any-positive support changes mechanically with R; store successes/trials and never compare different R values as if their labels had identical semantics
interpretation_guards.training: these cases are mechanism-diagnostic evidence and must remain separate from p0 reference validation/test and from formal research training until admission gates pass
